laptop-4c: Scaling with core count on the development laptop. One-way inference only: a miss here makes a miss on a Raspberry Pi 5 very likely; a pass says nothing about the Pi.
laptop-1c: Single-core scaling on the development laptop. One-way inference only (see laptop-4c).
arm-cloud: Real ARM server-class shared cloud VM (GitHub Actions). Noisy. NOT a Raspberry Pi.
pi5: Raspberry Pi 5 measurement. Valid only when this profile is run on a real Pi 5; the CPU model recorded in run.json must say so.
